title: Regional disaster-recovery strategy
problem: Recover a revenue-critical application from regional unavailability within approved recovery objectives using evidence rather than an untested architecture diagram.

requirements.availability: Regional recovery path with quarterly evidence
requirements.security: Recovery preserves identity, encryption, logging, data classification and change control
requirements.cost: Pilot-light baseline with explicit scale-up cost and business approval

architecture.summary: Infrastructure definitions, immutable artifacts, replicated data and minimal regional dependencies support controlled pilot-light activation and DNS traffic shift.
services: RDS cross-Region replica or backup copy

decisions: Recovery is a versioned runbook with named decision authority
Recovery identity, keys, secrets and logs are available without weakening controls
Pilot light matches 60/15-minute objectives after measured scale-up
Recovery capacity scaling is load-tested before an incident
Pilot light selected over warm standby after business-impact analysis
Recovery retains only justified standby capacity and data

failure_modes.impact: Customer transactions fail until recovery is activated
failure_modes.mitigation: Declare disaster, activate pilot light, verify dependencies and shift traffic
failure_modes.prevention: Quarterly timed exercises and dependency inventory

failure_modes.incident: Replicated data is corrupt or too stale
failure_modes.detection: Replication lag, consistency validation and restore test
failure_modes.mitigation: Select verified recovery point and communicate data-loss window
failure_modes.prevention: Point-in-time recovery, immutable backups and application reconciliation design

decisions.decision: Use pilot light rather than backup/restore or warm standby
decisions.trade_off: Moderate ongoing cost with more activation work than warm standby
decisions.revisit_when: RTO, revenue impact or scale-up evidence changes

decisions.decision: Shift traffic only after automated business verification
decisions.trade_off: May add minutes to recovery while reducing failed cutover risk
decisions.revisit_when: Verification becomes the dominant RTO component
